GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package closes audit findings F03 and F04. It combines language-level containment with an operating-system boundary because neither WASM imports nor process supervision alone controls all host resources.

Alternatives.Alternative: Run generated Rust binaries as ordinary child processes. Rejected because same-account native code has ambient OS authority.
Run WASM in the kernel process only. Rejected because a runtime or host-function bug would share the kernel blast radius.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The exact Windows sandbox primitive is selected by a bounded spike and negative tests during planning.
Component signing and marketplace review remain outside this runtime package.

Scenarios.Scenario: A generated feature requests network without a handle and receives a denial before any socket is opened.
A malicious component exhausts fuel; its runtime is terminated while normal browsing and recovery remain available.
